summary: Frontend-only verification of the sitewide liquid-glass Button restyle. Logged in as testpro@test.com and walked through landing → auth → dashboard → pipeline → deal modal. All glass buttons remain clickable, forms submit, no layout breakage, no z-index/overlay regressions from the glass lens. 5/5 scenarios PASS with 3 minor visual-inconsistency findings (not blockers).

issues: data-testid='auth-submit-btn' renders with a SOLID WHITE background (computed bg=rgb(255,255,255)) and dark text, instead of the translucent frosted-glass surface used elsewhere. The glass-lens inset box-shadow IS applied (so visually it still has the glass edge), but the white fill stands out vs. every other glass CTA. Likely a className override on the submit button in AuthPage.js that the new variant didn't override. Verify this is intentional (per the brief, 'white featured pricing CTAs intentionally keep their explicit white styling' — but it was unclear if auth-submit-btn is on that allow-list).

'Generate Insights' button bg=rgb(147,51,234) — solid purple, not glass. The glass-lens inset shadow is applied, but the explicit purple background overrides bg-white/10. Inconsistent with the rest of the glass-restyled buttons on the dashboard ('Add New Deal', 'Analyze Pricing', 'Check Customer Health', 'Optimize Conversions', 'View Full Analytics' all correctly render glass at bg=rgba(255,255,255,0.04)).

Hero 'Get Started' button: bg=rgba(255,255,255,0.1) (correct glass tint) but the computed box-shadow does NOT contain an 'inset' shadow — so the glass-lens edge highlight is missing on this hero CTA specifically. It still looks like a frosted pill, just without the layered lens. Possibly a className override hiding the shadow, or a different button component on the landing hero. Other landing/dashboard glass buttons correctly include the inset lens shadow.

verified_scenarios: Landing: page loads (title 'InFlow | Revenue Intelligence'), 30 button-like elements rendered, Termly cookie banner dismissed via Accept. 'View Pricing' scrolls page (scrollY 0 → 3670). 'Get Started' navigates to /auth?trial=true — PASS

Auth: /auth?mode=login renders; 'Continue with Email' (data-testid='auth-email-btn') is glass (bg=rgba(255,255,255,0.04), inset lens shadow present) and clickable — PASS. Filled testpro@test.com / password, clicked auth-submit-btn (pointer-events:auto, glass-lens shadow present) → landed on /dashboard — PASS

Dashboard: sidebar nav text-buttons Pipeline → /pipeline, Integrations → /connect-business work via click. Page renders with charts (Revenue Trend, Pipeline, Customer Health, Conversion Rate, AI Insights) — PASS

Pipeline: data-testid='add-deal-btn' is glass (bg=rgba(255,255,255,0.1), inset lens shadow, pointer-events:auto), clicking opens 'Add New Deal' modal. data-testid='deal-submit-btn' (Create Deal) visible, glass-styled (bg=rgba(255,255,255,0.1), inset lens), pointer-events:auto — PASS. The glass-lens box-shadow does NOT block clicks (verified clickability on add-deal-btn) — PASS

Visual audit on /dashboard: all 5 primary card CTAs ('Add New Deal' through 'View Full Analytics') correctly render as glass=True with bg=rgba(255,255,255,0.04) and white text — legible and consistent. Ghost icon buttons (search, notifications, kebab) render minimal/transparent as expected. No invisible/clipped/zero-size buttons detected — PASS
action_items: Decide whether auth-submit-btn should be glass (translucent) or solid white. If it should be glass, find the className override in /app/frontend/src/pages/AuthPage.js that's forcing rgb(255,255,255) and remove it so the default variant takes over.
Convert 'Generate Insights' (AI Insights card on /dashboard) to the glass variant — currently still has bg=rgb(147,51,234) solid purple override.
Optional: re-check landing hero 'Get Started' to confirm whether the missing inset lens shadow on this specific button is intentional or another classname override.
critical_code_review_comments: button.jsx GLASS_LENS box-shadow is correctly a non-blocking pure CSS effect on the button itself (verified add-deal-btn and deal-submit-btn click through cleanly — the brief's main concern was unfounded).
Console emits 4 repeated 401 errors on every page load before AuthContext hydrates the cookie session — same noise flagged in iteration_38. Harmless but worth gating render on auth-resolved state.
Recurring React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on the Add Deal modal — minor a11y nit on Pipeline.js Dialog.
Recurring Recharts warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on dashboard — chart container is being measured before layout settles. Cosmetic, no visible bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 scenarios PASS; 3 minor visual inconsistencies noted)
